structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a creative photo studio building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant vintage camera on its roof.
character: young photography intern (an East Asian woman in her early 20s, black bob, mustard beanie, camera strap round her neck)
scenes: she arrives with a coffee and charges camera batteries, lenses lined up on a table.
she sets up soft box lights and a paper backdrop for a product shoot.
she holds a round reflector while a photographer shoots a model sitting on a stool.
she sits at a computer picking photos from a screen showing a grid of abstract thumbnails, one marked with a star.
she retouches a single photo on a tablet with a stylus beside abstract colour sliders; dusk through the window.
props: a giant camera lens, a roll of film, a light bulb, a tripod, a reflector, an aperture shape, a memory card

steps.title: Kit check
steps.body: Charge batteries and pack the lenses.

steps.title: Set the lights
steps.body: Build the set for the shoot.

steps.title: Assist the shoot
steps.body: Hold reflectors and keep shots organised.

steps.title: Pick the best
steps.body: Choose the strongest frames from hundreds.

steps.title: Edit and deliver
steps.body: Retouch and send the final images.
